title: Kenvue hails overall bump in Q3 2026 results despite mixed beauty sales
summary: Despite Kenvue’s Q3 2026 net sales rising 3.2% to $3.8 billion, the Johnson & Johnson (J&J) spinoff consumer health company’s skin health and beauty sales division only saw sales increase by 0.1%

extraction.key_fact: Kenvue의 3분기 전체 매출은 늘었지만 스킨 헬스·뷰티 부문 매출은 거의 제자리였다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Kenvue hails overall bump in Q3 2026 results despite mixed beauty sales
